rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: The Nessus MCP server provides 12 tools for executing Nessus vulnerability scans, enriching findings with NVD CVSS scores and CISA KEV exploitation data, correlating vulnerabilities with asset ownership via a SQLite CMDB, and generating prioritized remediation reports. Rather than listing individual CVEs, it clusters related vulnerabilities into actionable fix tasks and can route remediation assignments to asset owners.
